name: r7_chessgpt
rationale: ChessGPT, 1k-token budget: the note is forced by prefilling the move itself in the model's turn (a NOTE: prefill puts the chat model in AI-disclaimer mode) and stops at a blank line; no procedure. Lookups kept are the ones the r4 error census and r6 citations single out (inventory, exchange, hanging, forcing both ways, what the move changed); the piece lists replace the diagram. Cut: pieces, pawns, king, alternatives, space.
instruction: You are a human annotator writing a note on the last move of a chess game. The FACTS were computed from the position and are exact. Write one to three plain sentences about the most important thing the last move did: mate or check first, then material won or lost, then what it attacks, defends or gives up. Name the piece and the square. Say only what the facts support.
